feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Former Goldman Sachs chief leaves Britain amid tax hike fears
articles.summary: A former Goldman Sachs chief who sits on the board of Revolut, Europe's most valuable private technology company, has become the latest prominent financier to leave the country amid concerns about Britain’s rising tax burden.

articles.title: Airbnb hosts can't ask guests to do 'chores' anymore in rule change
articles.summary: Airbnb hosts will no longer be able to ask guests to do the dishes or strip the beds under new rules announced by the platform.

articles.title: Volvo Cars in share price crash as 2,500 job cuts follow sales slump
articles.summary: Volvo Cars has revealed a further 2,500 job cuts amid a slump in sales that has seen its share price crash to record lows.

articles.title: European football giants to meet in London for NBA basketball talks
articles.summary: A cluster of European football giants will convene in London next week for talks as they try to finalise a string of deals for European basketball teams worth billions of dollars.

articles.title: The £1,000 mistake people are making with new iPhone purchase
articles.summary: Apple's new iPhone Duo is the company's first foldable device - but at £1,999, it's not cheap.

articles.title: Clubs face £20m bill for football watchdog's new levy
articles.summary: English football clubs face a roughly £20m annual bill to fund the sport's new watchdog - double the estimate provided by Sir Keir Starmer's government.

articles.title: Winter energy supply secure but possible 'tight days' for electricity - grid operators
articles.summary: Britain's energy supplies are secure for winter, national grid operators have said, despite expected higher gas demand at peak times and possible "tight days" for electricity.

articles.title: Post Office to launch first TV ads since Horizon scandal
articles.summary: The Post Office is to spend millions of pounds on its first television ads since the Horizon IT scandal, as it seeks to raise awareness of its range of bankjng services during a critical period for the state-owned company.

articles.title: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs in AI-led efficiency drive
articles.summary: Barclays has revealed it is cutting 5,000 jobs - 5% of its workforce - as part of efforts to save costs and drive efficiency through investment in artificial intelligence (AI).
